name: Charlemagne
description: Charlemagne is a trick-taking card game that involves tricks, trump, following suit. The game originated in Europe and has become popular worldwide.

overview.description: Charlemagne is a trick-taking card game that involves tricks, trump, following suit. The game originated in Europe and has become popular worldwide.

history.origins: Eastern Canada and Maine (USA). Euchre-based trick-taking; 4 players in fixed partnerships. Canadian form uses 34-card pack (Aâ€“7) plus two Jokers as top trumps; US form uses no Jokers, trump 9 as top. Single round of bidding; kitty of two cards.
timeline: Canadian: Jokers as top trumps; US: trump 9 highest
Played in Eastern Canada and Maine

setup.players: 4 players, two against two, partners opposite. Deal and play clockwise.
setup.deck: 34-card pack: Aâ€“7 in all suits, plus two distinguishable Jokers (Canadian). US: no Jokers, trump 9 is top trump.
setup.dealing: 8 cards each; dealer places 2 cards face down as kitty. Single round of bidding (left of dealer first, dealer last); bids must increase.
setup.equipment: 34-card pack + 2 Jokers (or 32-card no Jokers); score sheet.

rules.objective: Bid and make your contract (tricks) with partner. Trump: Jokers (or trump 9 in US) highest; Big Jack (trump J), Little Jack (same-colour J), then Aâ€“7. Follow suit; win tricks.
rules.gameplay: Bidding round; highest bidder names trump and may use kitty. Trick play: follow suit; Jokers and bowers (Jacks) as in Euchre. Making contract scores; failing loses. First side to target score wins.
